empty.title: No lists yet
empty.body: Start one and everyone here can shop from it

noAccess.title: Nothing shared with you yet
noAccess.body: This group has lists, and none of them are shared with you. Ask someone here to add you, or start your own

pending.title: Waiting to be let in
pending.body: Whoever runs the group decides. The lists appear here as soon as they do

gone.kicked: You are no longer in that group

ownerless.title: This group has no owner
ownerless.body: Whoever set it up deleted their account. It will be deleted unless an admin takes it on
ownerless.askAdmin: Ask an admin here to take it on

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: They lose this group and its lists. They can ask to join again with the code

ban.title: Remove and block {{name}}?
ban.body: They lose this group and cannot ask to join again, even with the code

transfer.title: Hand the group to {{name}}?
transfer.body: They become the owner and you become an admin. Only they can hand it back

regenerate.title: Make a new code?
regenerate.body: The old code stops working, so anyone you already sent it to will need the new one

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Every list in this group goes, for everyone in it. This cannot be undone
delete.typeName: Type the group's name to confirm

rename.title: Change name here
rename.body: This is the name the other people in this group see. It changes nothing anywhere else
rename.label: Name in this group

newList.title: Name the list
newList.body: Anyone in this group can start a list. You can rename it later
newList.label: List name
newList.shareLabel: Everyone in the group can see it
newList.shareHint: They can add to it and tick things off. Turn this off to keep it to yourself, and share it with whoever you choose later

error.notAvailable: This group is not available to you. It may have been deleted, or you may have been removed
error.roleChanged: Your role in this group changed
error.alreadyClaimed: Somebody else has already taken this group on
error.tooManyRenames: Too many name changes. You can change it again in {{wait}}
error.failed: That did not go through. Try again

indicator.notAvailable: Not in the shop last time

lost.title: You have lost connection
lost.body: Check your wifi or mobile data. This page reloads on its own as soon as you are back.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.body: Sign in and your groups come with you, on any phone

register.title: Make an account
register.body: So your lists are not tied to one phone

upgrade.title: Keep what you have
upgrade.body: Add an email and a password to the account already on this phone. Nothing moves and nothing is lost
upgrade.keepsafe_one: Your group and everything in it stay exactly where they are. This is the same account, with a way back into it
upgrade.keepsafe_other: Your {{count}} groups and everything in them stay exactly where they are. This is the same account, with a way back into it
upgrade.done: Your account is secured. Sign in anywhere with {{email}}

verify.confirmedBody: {{email}} is yours. You can sign in with it on any phone
verify.confirmedBodyNoEmail: Your email is confirmed. You can sign in with it on any phone
verify.expiredBody: Confirmation links last a short while and work once. Nothing is wrong with your account: signing in and everything else works exactly the same

nudge.title: Confirm your email
nudge.body: We sent a link to {{email}}. You can carry on without it, but confirming keeps the account yours

resend.sent: Sent again. You can ask for another in {{wait}}
resend.sentNoWait: Sent again. Give it a minute to arrive
resend.refused: Too many requests. You can ask for another in {{wait}}
resend.refusedNoWait: Too many requests. Try again in a while

error.badCredentials: That email and password do not match. Check both and try again
error.emailTaken: That email already has an account
error.badEmail: That does not look like an email address
error.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again

createZone.title: Name your group
createZone.body: A group is the household or flatmates you share lists with. You can change the name later
createZone.label: Group name
createZone.mintingAccount: We are setting up an account on this phone so the group has an owner. You can add an email to it whenever you like

joinZone.title: Enter the code
joinZone.body: Whoever set the group up can find its code on the group's page
joinZone.label: Join code
joinZone.hint: Letters and numbers. Never O, I or L

joinLink.title: Someone wants you on their list
joinLink.body: Ask to join, and whoever runs the group lets you in. You will see the group and its lists once they do
joinLink.guestNotice: Asking makes an account on this phone. Add an email to it later so you do not lose it
joinLink.installNote: Installing keeps Velista on your home screen. Either way you are asking to join the same group

invite.title: {{name}} is yours
invite.body: Send this code to the people you shop with. They enter it to ask to join
invite.newCode: This is your new code. The old one has stopped working

asked.title: You asked to join {{name}}
asked.body: Whoever runs the group decides. This page updates the moment they do, and the group opens up below

error.noSuchZone: No group has that code. Check it with whoever sent it. Codes never use O, I or L
error.alreadyAsked: You have already asked to join this group
error.notAllowed: You cannot join this group. Ask whoever runs it
error.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again
error.createClash: Something clashed on our side. Try that again
error.signedOut: You have been signed out. Try that again to carry on
error.failed: That did not go through. Try again

accountLost.title: We lost the account on this phone
accountLost.body: Your groups were tied to this phone and we cannot reach them any more. You can start again, and adding an email next time means this cannot happen

hero.body: Shared shopping lists for the people you actually shop with. Changes show up on everyone's phone as they happen.

home.zoneExplainer: A group is the household or flatmates you share lists with. You can start without an account.

guest.title: You are shopping as a guest
guest.body: This phone is the only thing holding your account. Add an email or Google to keep your groups and lists if you lose it.

empty.title: No groups yet
empty.body: A group is the household or flatmates you share lists with. Start one, or join someone else's with their code.

error.title: We could not load your groups
error.body: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing you saved has been lost.

presence.more_one: {{name}} and {{count}} more are on the list
presence.more_other: {{name}} and {{count}} more are on the list
presence.show: See who is on the list
presence.hide: Hide who is on the list

add.micRefused: Velista cannot hear you. The microphone is switched off for this app, so turn it back on in your browser, or type it instead
add.micMissing: There is no microphone on this device, so type it instead
add.voiceFailed: That did not send. Nothing was added, so try again or type it
add.voiceBusy: A lot of people are asking at once. Try again in {{count}} seconds

empty.title: Nothing on this list yet
empty.body: Write the first thing and everyone here sees it

readOnly.banner: You can read this list, not change it

line.overwritten: {{name}} changed this while you were editing
line.overwrittenBySomeone: Somebody else changed this while you were editing
line.failed: That did not save. Tap to try again

reorder.title: Put them in order
reorder.body: Drag by the grip. Ticking off is off while you are in here
reorder.started: Putting them in order. Ticking off is off

edit.title: Change this line
edit.remainder_one: The one you are not bringing back stays on the list, marked as not in the shop
edit.remainder_other: The {{count}} you are not bringing back stay on the list, marked as not in the shop

deleteLine.title: Take {{name}} off the list?
deleteLine.body: It goes for everyone, along with anything said about it

deleteList.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteList.body: Every line on it goes, for everyone in the group. This cannot be undone
deleteList.typeName: Type the list's name to confirm

comments.title: About {{name}}
comments.readOnly: You can read the comments here, not add to them
comments.recordingEmpty: That recording came out empty. Try again
comments.recordingTooBig: That recording is over the {{limit}} MB limit, so it did not send. It is still here
comments.micRefused: Velista could not use the microphone. Check the permission in your browser, or type it instead
comments.noTranscript: A recording. It could not be written down

limit.reached: That is a minute, so I stopped recording.

settings.title: List settings
settings.name: List name

autoApprove.label: Add without asking
autoApprove.hint: New lines go straight onto the list instead of waiting for approval. The ones already waiting stay as they are

sharedWithZone.label: Everybody in this group can use this list
sharedWithZone.hint: People who join later get it too. Turning this off does not take it away from anybody who already has it

settings.accessFor: What {{name}} can do with this list

access.decide: Can tick off and decide what goes on it
access.creator: Created this list
access.staffNote: Group admins always have full access to every list in the group. This cannot be changed here
access.manageLocked: Only group admins can appoint list admins

gone.unshared: That list is no longer shared with you

error.notAvailable: This list is not available to you. It may have been deleted, or it may no longer be shared with you
error.readOnly: You can read this list, not change it
error.roleChanged: Your role in this group changed
error.tooFast: Slow down for a moment and try again
error.failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment

detail.title: About this line
detail.namesFailed: Product names could not be loaded
detail.howManyNote: Prefilled with the whole outstanding quantity. Buying fewer leaves the rest wanted
detail.failed: That did not save. Try again

page.prices: Where to buy it, and for how much: drawn here once prices exist. Nothing is shown until then.
page.rate: about how often you buy it

confirmDelete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
confirmDelete.body: Its buy history goes with it. A line at zero keeps its history and costs nothing; deleting is for things this list should not know about any more.

buying.notMine: Anybody can add to this list. Buying is for whoever does the shopping

name.label: Name
name.hint: This is the name other people in your groups see

scope.matching: Change it in my groups too
scope.matchingHint: Groups where you chose a different name keep it
scope.globalOnlyHint: Every group keeps the name it has now

email.label: Email
email.failed: We could not read your account details

password.label: Password
password.body: We send a link to {{email}}. Using it signs you out on your other phones, and keeps you signed in here
password.sent: If that address has a password, a link is on its way

signOut.body: Signs you out on this phone. Your other phones stay signed in

guest.title: This account lives on this phone
guest.body: There is no email and no password on it yet, so it cannot be opened anywhere else, and clearing this browser's data would end it
guest.deleteNote: In order to log out you need to delete your account because it is not secured to an email

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.body: Your email, your password and your name go for good. This cannot be undone
delete.ownedZones_one: You own 1 group. It will be deleted unless an admin in it takes it on
delete.ownedZones_other: You own {{count}} groups. They will be deleted unless an admin in each takes them on
delete.authored: What you added to other people's lists stays, with your name taken off it

error.tooManyRenames: Too many name changes. You can change it again in {{wait}}
error.tooManyResets: Too many requests. You can ask for another in {{wait}}
error.badName: Names are 2 to 40 characters, and can use letters, numbers, spaces and . _ ' -
error.failed: That did not go through. Try again

sendOnSilence.label: Send when I stop talking
sendOnSilence.hint: The recording ends by itself after a moment of quiet, instead of waiting for you to press stop. Useful with your hands full, and it will cut you off if you pause to think.

keepListening.label: Keep listening after sending
keepListening.hint: The microphone stays open once a recording is on its way, so you can name several things in a row. The bin closes it.

app.installDetail: Keep Velista on your home screen. It opens on its own and works without a signal
app.add: Add it to your home screen
app.addDetail: Three steps, and your browser does the rest
app.elsewhereDetail: Velista has its own address, {{origin}}. That is where it can be installed

install.title: Keep Velista on your phone
install.body: It sits on your home screen like any other app, opens on its own, and your lists are there when the signal is not
install.note: Nothing is downloaded from a store. You can remove it the same way you remove any app

manual.reveal: Prefer to do it by hand?

installed.title: Velista is installed
installed.body: You are reading this inside the app. It is on your home screen, and it opens without the browser
installed.reveal: Not on your home screen? Show the steps

elsewhere.title: Velista has its own address
elsewhere.body: You are reading the portfolio’s copy. Velista is installed at {{origin}}, where it has its own icon and its own name

iosSafari.heading: Add it from Safari
iosSafari.step1: Tap Share, in the bar at the bottom
iosSafari.step2: Scroll down and choose Add to Home Screen
iosSafari.step3: Tap Add, at the top right

androidMenu.heading: Add it from your browser menu
androidMenu.step1: Open the browser menu, usually three dots
androidMenu.step2: Choose Install app, or Add to Home screen
androidMenu.step3: Confirm, and it lands on your home screen

desktopChromium.heading: Add it from the address bar
desktopChromium.step1: Look at the right hand end of the address bar for the install icon
desktopChromium.step3: If it is not there, open the browser menu and look for Install Velista

desktopFirefox.title: Firefox cannot keep this as an app
desktopFirefox.body: Not on the desktop. Velista works perfectly in this tab, and if you want the window, open Velista in Chrome, Edge or Safari on this machine and install it there
desktopFirefox.bookmark: Or press Ctrl D to bookmark it and pin the tab. Velista remembers where you were either way

fullscreen.title: The whole screen
fullscreen.body: No address bar, no tabs. Just the lists

oneTap.title: One tap from the home screen
oneTap.body: Beside everything else you open without thinking

offline.title: Opens without a signal
offline.body: The last list you looked at is still readable in the shop

announce.ready: Your browser can install Velista. The button is at the top of the page

assistant.title: Assistant

intro.lead: Tell me what you need. For example:

ask.label: Ask about a list
ask.said: “Is there milk on the weekly shop?”

composer.label: Write a message to the assistant

recorder.refused: I cannot hear you. The microphone is switched off for this app
recorder.unavailable: This browser cannot record. You can still type

limit.longest: Five minutes is the longest I can listen.
limit.reached: That is five minutes, so I stopped listening.

busy.body: A lot of people are asking at once. I will be ready in a moment, and your message is still here.
busy.noNumber: A lot of people are asking at once. Try me again in a moment, and your message is still here.

assistant.failed: That did not reach me. Your message is still here, so try again.
assistant.unconfigured: The assistant is not switched on here. That is on us, not on you, and trying again will not change it.
assistant.dropped: The start of this conversation is too long to keep, so I let it go.
assistant.spoken: You said something. I am listening to it now.
assistant.tooLong: That recording was too big to send. I can take up to {{limit}} MB at a time, so a shorter message will get through.
assistant.badFormat: Your browser recorded that in a way I cannot read. You can still type it.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Until you name it, it shows as {{name}}

postal.label: Postal codes
postal.name: Label, optional
postal.full: You can keep up to {{count}} postal codes
postal.uncovered: No supermarket we know reaches this code yet

chains.label: Supermarkets
chains.hint: The whole chain, never one shop. An excluded chain stays here so it can come back

saving.label: A second stop must save at least

scope.banner: Add a postal code or choose a supermarket to see prices

delete.label: Delete {{name}}
delete.title: Delete this profile?
delete.body: Its postal codes and supermarket choices go with it. Your lists are not touched

error.load: We could not read your profiles
error.save: That did not save. Try again
error.delete: That did not go through. Try again

basket.title: Shopping list
basket.emptyHint: Whoever made it has not put anything on it yet.

revoked.title: You are no longer on this list
revoked.body: Whoever shared it has taken it back. If you still have the link, you can join again.

settle.title: {{name}}
settle.failed: That did not save. Try again.
settle.missed_one: One household on this line could not be updated.
settle.missed_other: {{count}} households on this line could not be updated.

product.title: Which one did you get?
product.hint: Any of these counts as this line. Pick the one in your trolley.

allocate.title: {{name}} · got {{count}}
allocate.hint: Which list gets how many. Starts from oldest first, which is what one tap would have done.
allocate.over: That is more than you got

people.title: On this list
people.open: See who is on this list

share.title: Share this list
share.body: Anyone with the link can shop it, no account needed. They see the lines, never your groups.
share.note: This is the list’s one link. Copy it again whenever you need it, for as many people as you like. It stops working when the list is done or when you revoke it.

revoke.title: Revoke the link?
revoke.body_one: Nobody new will be able to join, and the list will have no link until you share it again. The {{count}} person already shopping keeps working.
revoke.body_other: Nobody new will be able to join, and the list will have no link until you share it again. The {{count}} people already shopping keep working.
revoke.bodyNone: Nobody new will be able to join, and the list will have no link until you share it again.
revoke.cascade_one: Also remove the {{count}} guest who joined with it
revoke.cascade_other: Also remove the {{count}} guests who joined with it
revoke.cascadeHint: They lose the list on their next action. Only tick this if the link reached the wrong hands.

join.nameHint: So people know who got the bread
join.install: Keep it on your home screen while you shop
join.dead: This link is no longer accepting people
join.deadBody: Ask whoever sent it for a new one. If you were already shopping this list, your own link in this browser still works.
join.failed: That did not work. Try again.

getList.title: Get shopping list
getList.body: One list to carry around the shop, from everything still needed in the lists you choose.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Left empty, the list shows its date; a second one the same day gets a number

sources.label: Draw from
sources.hint: Only lists where you can edit appear. A group checked whole includes lists made later.
sources.none: You need a group where you can edit lists first

getList.error: That did not go through. Try again

empty.title: No shopping lists yet
empty.body: Generate one from everything still needed across your groups, and it will be kept here.

error.title: We could not load your shopping lists
error.body: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing you saved has been lost.
